steps.content: FAC Sun Crow Operation Temporary Command.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The conditions of BR-001 and BR-002 ruins have been confirmed. We must focus on stopping the Sun Crow at DisSea. We're out of men. Tell the garrisons to hold on.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: What about BR-004?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Sir, BR-004 is showing severe contamination spillage and the temperature is abnormally high. Many devices are malfunctioning, and some soldiers at the garrison are experiencing severe mental contamination.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The whole city's temperature is abnormally high! Specifically, where? How many degrees? Rate of temperature increase? Any singularities?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Search for the Sun Crow's kin or any other weird signs. We need to locate the Sun Crow quickly!
The heat has the entire troop on edge. The rampaging Apostle is attacking the Broken Frontline while constantly switching locations. This makes the FAC's defense work even more challenging.
He must admit that a part of him misses the times when those patterned green lights were still around. But currently, the battlefield doesn't afford him the leisure to ponder various what-ifs.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: The condition of BR-004 is yet to be confirmed. But the MBCC's Chief is already heading there...

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: What did you say?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Dammit! Chief's shackles haven't recovered yet. Who knows what might happen if Chief gets in contact with the Apostle again? Go help them now!
Inside the Statue of Keylan

The damaged stairs aren't fully restored yet, and neither is your body. The fever makes your steps unsteady. You have to stop occasionally for a breather before resuming the climb as quickly as possible.

Having broken free and being near the DisSea, the Sun Crow Apostle has gone completely berserk. The high heat within a radius of a hundred meters from it is almost devoid of any living things. You're physically unable to get close. Nor can any normal human.
Although the FAC hasn't said anything, you know that if this continues, they'll only receive one last order: Eliminate the Sun Crow at all costs.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Chief, please stop, don't push yourself anymore. Leave the inspection work to us. What would we do if something happened to you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, even if it's risky, I must verify some things... It's a job only I can do, I'm afraid.
If all of the Three Calamities are escalating, then the Wraith Spirit must be here too. Whether it's an enemy or an ally, it's what's closest to the Sun Crow Apostle.
With this thought, you reach out to grasp the scalding doorknob to push it open.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Chief, wait! Let me open the door. Let me do it...
You fling the door open. A wave of heat hits you as countless fiery birds flap their wings in the air, screeching. The soldiers guard before you swiftly.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Please step back. You're not fit for battle right now!

options: No... Now is exactly when I need to play my part.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: What?!

You look ahead. In the center of the rooftop's inferno, amid countless specters of the mythical bird, a mass of pitch-black flames burns. It's unlike any of the Wraith Spirits around. The figure within it watches you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you the Wraith Spirit who tested Yanyan? The remnant of the Sun Crow Apostle?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or should I call you... the former Great Seer of Eastia's Sunset Town, the Sinner who invaded my consciousness through the shackles?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's been a while... Since the Sun Crow was released, I've been having a 40-degree fever, yet I didn't dream of you again. You've been corrupted by the contamination too. Does it hurt?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But regardless, I need your guidance. So, I came to see you.
Amid the intense Mania field, you summon the shackles effortlessly and take a step forward. The shadow shrieks, and suddenly, all the specters of the Wraith Spirit on the rooftop rush toward you!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: No! Chief, don't use the shackles, you'll...
